query: AWS Bedrock generative AI demand contribution to revenue
normalized: ai aws bedrock contribution demand generative revenue

output.content:
AWS’s **generative-AI business exceeded a $25 billion annualized revenue run rate in Q2 2026**, growing at a triple-digit year-over-year rate; this is the company’s disclosed aggregate AI revenue measure, rather than a standalone Bedrock revenue figure. [[1]] 

Against AWS’s **$169 billion annualized revenue run rate** in Q2 2026, the disclosed AI run rate represents **at least ~14.8% of AWS revenue** ($25 billion ÷ $169 billion); because Amazon said “more than” $25 billion, the actual contribution is higher. [[2]] [[1]] 

Bedrock is a major demand indicator within that AI total, but Amazon does **not** separately quantify Bedrock’s revenue contribution. In Q2, Bedrock customers spent more than in all preceding quarters combined, while hundreds of thousands of customers were using the service. [[1]] 

The contribution has expanded rapidly: AWS AI revenue was **over $15 billion annualized in Q1 2026**, or roughly **10.6%** of AWS’s then-$142 billion revenue run rate, and Bedrock customer spend grew **170% sequentially** in that quarter. [[3]] [[4]]

**Bottom line:** for modeling, a defensible current estimate is that AWS generative AI contributes **more than $25 billion annualized, or at least ~15% of AWS revenue**, with Bedrock an important but undisclosed subset; it should not be modeled as a separately reported revenue line. [[1]]
